document.about: Kohler K-R33912 kitchen faucet specification sheet (3 pages, printed by Chrome). The first page opens on a title block; the two after it run the same two lines small at their top right.

notes: #164: Codes/Standards sets one standard per line, well short of the column's measure; Installation Notes sets a short note over a longer one.

checks.issue: The standards read two and three to a paragraph: `ASME A112.18.1/CSA B125.1 NSF/ANSI/CAN 372`.
As above: `DOE - Energy Policy Act 1992 California Energy Commission (CEC) ADA`.
The first Installation Note ran into the second: `ADA compliant for faucet handles only ADA, CSA B651 compliant…`.

element.text: ADA compliant for faucet handles only
